findings.finding: Formula Systems, Asseco's fully consolidated Israeli subsidiary and roughly half of group revenue, reported a record Q3 2026 on 11-25 at 15:16 Warsaw: revenue +22.1% to $850.9m and operating income +37.2% to $74.9m, so the largest segment of the Asseco Q3 print is already known to be strong in USD.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Asseco's own last reported-quarter beat (Q2 2026, net +8.6% and EBITDA +5.3% vs PAP consensus) was sold -2.65% on 2026-08-28; the Q3 2025 beat (171.1 vs 161) rose +3.89% on 2025-12-02.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 6-K was public 1h45m before the 11-25 close (ACP closed 210.8, roughly flat from 210.3 at seal) and the 11-26 session runs before an evening Asseco release. What may remain unpriced is that Polish sell-side Q3 numbers for the group were built before Formula's print; if they had been updated, the -16% 20-day slide would not coincide with a record quarter at half the group. Net of the rest: the Asseco Poland and Asseco International segments and USD/PLN translation (unknown) must not offset it; nothing public covers them for Q3.
